notes.title: Version 1.2 - the "Post-EGX" update - is here!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32940452/645aafffe6a9118a97454a590803d0851a9039ab.png[/img]

After showing our game at [b]EGX[/b], we've had the great fortune of seeing so many people play 999 [i](and drive themselves crazy in the process!)[/i]
What we've also noticed is a few things that we've needed to fix and a few suggestions we've taken on board!

[b]NEW[/b]
[list][*]You can now move by clicking anywhere on the screen rather than just on the player
[*]You can now move much faster through the time trial scores by holding down the mouse button
[*]You can now change the indicator that comes from the player when you're ready to move in the "Effects" menu to make it more obvious if needed
[*]You can now change the movement line indicator in the "Effects" menu to be either a dot, a square or a dash
[*]ALL NEW Tutorial, the tutorial has been overhauled and is now MUCH better
[/list]

[b]FIXED[/b]
[list][*]Timed & button blocks timing out on top of you will now properly kill you instead of sometimes just trapping you
[*]Freshly spawned break-blocks will not be destroyed again if a bomb is still exploding after you've died
[*]Gravity Boxes now take the colour of the primary colour scheme, rather than the secondary so that they will stand out a bit more
[*]Amended Level 012 to allow better maneuverability
[*]Amended Level 123 to fix minor bug
[*]Amended Level 124 to fix 'quick exit' trick
[*]Amended Level 127 to be 'slightly' easier
[*]Amended Level 135 to be 'slightly' easier
[*]Amended Level 184 to allow better maneuverability
[*]Amended Level 200 to allow better maneuverability
[*]Removed some minor left-over testing elements within game-play
[/list]

[i]If [b]YOU[/b] notice any glitches or bugs, [b]PLEASE[/b] get in touch and we'll be all over it![/i]

notes.title: Mix up how you play - Version 1.1a is here!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32940452/c7c24e5f58bcb8fb3d0554c92342ee9c4f47b0e7.png[/img]

Mix up how you play - [b]Upgrade to Version 1.1a[/b]

[b]NEW Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Effects menu has been revamped - the "On/Less/Off" applies to particle effects now and more effect options have been added
[*]Adjust the level of screen shake
[*]Turn on/off screen rotation during gravity switching
[*]Adjust the level transition brightness (darker options are easier on the eye)
[*]The music option is no longer just "On/Off", volume control has been added
[/list]

[i]These features were submitted by YOU (well, not specifically you, unless it was you reading this who'd suggested this, but you get the idea!) - if [b]YOU[/b] have any suggestions to improve your experience with 999, please let us know![/i]

notes.title: Version 1.1 is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32940452/66fe853f972e0238b8e6be5f14f6b819b9899a56.png[/img]

We've [i]really[/i] been enjoying watching you stream 999 on twitch! Thankfully, watching those streams has highlighted a few bugs that have needed squashing! So here's what's new in Version 1.1:

[b]FIXED[/b]
[list]
[*]The glitches surrounding the buttons have now been addressed, the button is much smoother to prevent getting stuck inside it
[*]The menu options that require you to reach a certain level to unlock now show correctly when you unlock them
[*]Level 58 - The tricky 1-gap jump in this level has now been changed to a 2-gap jump
[*]Level 82 - The star is now slightly more obtainable (we've increased the cog barriers near it to require 12 cogs instead of 9)
[*]Level 83 - A few minor adjustments to make the upper route easier to access
[*]Level 91 - The entire level has been shuffled down slightly to allow the upper parts of the level easier to navigate
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]We know that the bounce block can sometimes react differently to how it should - we are working to resolve this
[/list]

[i]If [b]YOU[/b] notice any glitches or bugs, [b]PLEASE[/b] get in touch and we'll be all over it![/i]

notes.title: Version 1.0a - Optimisation Fixes are here!
notes.notes:
We've just released a small update [i](version 1.0a)[/i] - as we'd noticed that certain visual effects took a strain on the processing power and dropped frame-rates during streaming / live recording. These small fixes should be unnoticeable to most but should help with optimising live-streaming!

Incidentally, if you do stream 999 on Twitch, be sure to let people know as 999 is set up as a recognised game on Twitch!

https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/999
